Sidecar-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Extended-desktop marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Sidecar workflows — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Sidecar vs Universal Control vs AirPlay

US pages use "Sidecar", "Use iPad as a display", or "Extended desktop." China storefront copy often uses 随航 for Apple's feature name, 副屏 or 第二显示器 for second-screen benefit lines, iPad 外接显示器 when the gallery shows monitor-style framing, or 扩展桌面 for extended-desktop layouts — depending on whether you mean system Sidecar, in-app dual-screen layouts, or Pencil markup on the Sidecar canvas. AppLocale aligns phrasing with your actual scope and avoids conflating Sidecar with Universal Control (one cursor across separate devices), 隔空播放 (AirPlay casting), or 接力 (Handoff session resume) when your screenshots show iPad extending the Mac desktop.

Wired USB-C vs wireless Sidecar

Screenshot galleries may label USB-C wired Sidecar separately from wireless Sidecar over the same Apple ID. Buyers searching for low-latency creative workflows distinguish cable-connected Sidecar from wireless convenience — match what your English listing and screenshots actually show.

Apple Pencil markup vs in-app drawing

Pencil strokes on a Sidecar extended display (随航标注, Apple Pencil 标注) look different from standalone iPad drawing apps or Apple Pencil listing copy for iPad-native canvas tools. Do not use generic Pencil vocabulary on Sidecar frames unless that is what the screenshot depicts — see Apple Pencil listing guide only when Pencil-on-iPad-native-canvas is your lead story, not Pencil-on-Sidecar extended display.

Touch Bar on iPad vs MacBook Touch Bar

Sidecar can surface a software Touch Bar on the iPad screen (触控栏). Marketing copy should distinguish iPad-side Touch Bar from MacBook hardware Touch Bar badges unless your gallery shows each accurately.

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need second-display search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 随航, 副屏, and 扩展桌面 each signal different intent from Stage Manager, Split View, or AirPlay keywords.

AppLocale FAQ

Does AppLocale implement Sidecar or external display APIs?

No. We deliver Connect listing metadata copy only — name, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot caption lines. Sidecar display routing, external monitor integration, and USB-C wired display engineering are outside scope.

How is Sidecar listing copy different from Universal Control?

Sidecar makes iPad a true second Mac display — extended desktop, Pencil markup on the Sidecar canvas, sidebar or Touch Bar on iPad. Universal Control lets one keyboard and mouse control Mac and iPad as separate devices with separate displays; the cursor moves between screens but iPad is not an extended Mac monitor. How is this different from Handoff, Continuity Camera, Stage Manager, or AirPlay?

Handoff covers session resume between devices. Continuity Camera covers iPhone as Mac webcam. Stage Manager covers multitasking windowing on each device's own screen. AirPlay covers cast to TV and speakers. Sidecar covers iPad-as-Mac-second-display — see the cross-links above for each surface.
